mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(f.metric_code, CONCAT('TMP:', f.temp_metric_id)) AS metric_code, f.temp_metric_id, COALESCE(d.standard_name, t.display_name) AS standard_name, CASE WHEN f.temp_metric_id IS NULL THEN d.standard_unit ELSE t.unit_text END AS unit, f.sort_order FROM followed_metric f LEFT JOIN metric_definition d ON d.code = f.metric_code LEFT JOIN temp_metric t ON t.id = f.temp_metric_id WHERE f.profile_id = #{profileId} ORDER BY f.sort_order, f.id
